title.zh: W1 治理评估：`2026-10-11-roadmap-r06-p8` 伞卡能否按 R06 家族收口关闭——逐条 acceptance 映射与「不关闭」报告（只评估、不动卡）
title.en: W1 governance evaluation: can roadmap-r06-p8 umbrella be closed via the R06 family closeout? Per-item acceptance mapping and DO-NOT-CLOSE report (evaluation only)

intent.zh: 按 Chief 2026-11-11 派工：把 `2026-10-11-roadmap-r06-p8`（R06@P8 伞卡，proposed/checks=0）的 6 条 acceptance 逐条映射到 `2026-11-04-render-r06-flex-closeout`（verified）与 z2vec/allowlist 等证据，全部满足才关闭；任何一条需要超出家族收口的声明（动画一致性/等价/准入/NP）则不关闭、只出评估报告。本片只评估、**不改任何卡状态与依赖边**。
intent.en: Map the umbrella card's 6 acceptance items to R06 family closeout (verified) and related evidence; close only if all are satisfied. Any item requiring claims beyond the family closeout (animation consistency / equivalence / admission / NP) means DO NOT CLOSE and report only.

acceptance: 逐条映射 r06-p8 的 6 条 acceptance 到 R06 家族收口（`2026-11-04-render-r06-flex-closeout` verified）与 z2vec/allowlist 等证据，逐条给 met/unmet + 证据指针（evaluation.json 机器可读）
结论：**不关闭**伞卡——写明 unmet 项与「超出家族收口的声明」（动画与几何一致性、NP01/NP02 先核对、NP03/NP04 验收、性能）；并记录「伞卡 checks=0、阶段占位不可 start」；写清影响面（实际 depends_on/checks 引用数）且不动依赖边
证据落 docs/development-evidence/plan/w1-r06-p8-umbrella-closure-eval/（README/evaluation.json/receipt.json/manifest），含卡 id、收口卡 id、逐条指针与结论
不改任何卡状态/依赖边/判据/参考/容差；零 GPU、零窗；不宣称准入/等价/发布
四门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit + normify check/done；编码 UTF-8/LF 无 BOM
note: Chief 2026-11-11 派工：评估伞卡能否按 R06 家族收口关闭。结论按「全部满足才关」口径判定；本片只出评估报告，不改卡状态、不动依赖边。
